algorithm: XGBoost regressor on log1p(weekly cases), one model per horizon, pooled across locations

alert_rule.threshold: mean + 2 SD of weekly cases in the same week (+/- 2 weeks) of earlier years
alert_rule.crossing_forecast: P(cases >= threshold) >= a per-horizon cut-off chosen to maximise F1 on the validation period (never on the test period)
alert_rule.probability_method: empirical distribution of validation-period errors (log scale)
